# College Board

> The College Board is a mission-driven organization connecting students to college success through standardized testing (SAT, AP, ACCUPLACER), accommodations for students with disabilities (SSD), and validity research services (ACES).

College Board provides comprehensive educational assessment programs, disability accommodations through Services for Students with Disabilities (SSD Online), and research tools for institutions to validate placement and admission decisions. The organization serves students, educators, and higher education institutions with testing, support services, and data analytics.

## Key Topics

- SAT
- AP Exams
- ACCUPLACER
- Services for Students with Disabilities (SSD)
- SSD Online
- ACES (validity studies)
- Accommodations and disability services
- Student Eligibility Form
- Admission validity studies
- Placement validity studies
- Test units and pricing
- Advanced Algebra and Functions (AAF)
- Quantitative Reasoning, Algebra, and Statistics (QAS)
- WritePlacer
- TSIA2

## Accommodations and Disability Services

- [Taking AP Exams with Accommodations](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/how-accommodations-work/for-each-test/ap-exams): Guide for students taking AP Exams with SSD accommodations and supports
- [Why Documentation May Be Reviewed](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/request-accommodations/after-your-request/when-documentation-may-be-reviewed): Guide on College Board documentation review process for accommodations
- [Submit Additional Information Online](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/ssd-online/submit-additional-info): How-to guide for SSD coordinators to upload documentation via SSD Online
- [How do I become an SSD coordinator?](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/help-center/how-do-i-become-ssd-coordinator): FAQ on registering as SSD coordinator to access SSD Online system
- [Who can use SSD Online?](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/help-center/who-can-use-ssd-online): FAQ on SSD Online access eligibility for school coordinators only
- [Can the family submit an accommodation request without the school?](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/help-center/can-family-submit-accommodation-request-without-school): FAQ on family-submitted SSD accommodation requests via Student Eligibility Form

## ACCUPLACER Testing

- [How do ACCUPLACER test units work?](https://accuplacer.collegeboard.org/help-center/how-do-accuplacer-test-units-work): FAQ explaining ACCUPLACER test unit consumption and pricing structure
- [How do I order ACCUPLACER test units and how long will it take for my order to be processed?](https://accuplacer.collegeboard.org/help-center/how-do-i-order-accuplacer-test-units-and-how-long-will-it-take-my-order-be-processed): FAQ on ordering ACCUPLACER test units and COMPANION materials online

## ACES Validity Studies and Research

- [How should we choose predictors for an admission validity study?](https://aces.collegeboard.org/help-center/how-should-we-choose-predictors-admission-validity-study): FAQ on selecting SAT, AP, and custom predictors for ACES validity studies
- [What's the minimum number of students needed for a placement validity study?](https://aces.collegeboard.org/help-center/whats-minimum-number-students-needed-placement-validity-study): FAQ on minimum sample sizes for AP, CLEP, SAT, ACCUPLACER placement studies
- [Why would we want to request additional subgroups in an admission validity study?](https://aces.collegeboard.org/help-center/why-would-we-want-request-additional-subgroups-admission-validity-study): FAQ on subgroup analysis benefits in ACES admission validity studies
- [How should we handle student course grades of Fail, Incomplete, or Withdraw?](https://aces.collegeboard.org/help-center/how-should-we-handle-student-course-grades-fail-incomplete-or-withdraw): FAQ on handling F/I/W grades in ACES GPA calculations and grading scales
- [How should I label our student data file?](https://aces.collegeboard.org/help-center/how-should-i-label-our-student-data-file): FAQ on ACES student data file labeling per Data Preparation Guidelines
- [How do I look up the designated institution/College Board college code (dicode) for my institution or system?](https://aces.collegeboard.org/help-center/how-do-i-look-up-designated-institution-code-dicode): FAQ on looking up College Board institution codes (dicodes) for ACES
- [Contact Us – ACES](https://aces.collegeboard.org/contact-us): ACES contact information for SAT validity studies and data sharing support
